import hashlib, json, re, sqlite3, subprocess, sys, tempfile
from pathlib import Path

root = Path('products/services/sqlite-editorial-baseline')
lesson = (root / 'learner-exercise.md').read_bytes()
prior = json.loads((root / 'learner-exercise-verification.json').read_text())
assert hashlib.sha256(lesson).hexdigest() == prior['exercise_sha256'], 'Lesson differs from verified source'
blocks = re.findall(rb'(?m)^```python\s*\n(.*?)^```\s*$', lesson, re.S | re.M)
assert len(blocks) == 1, 'Expected one Python exercise'
script = blocks[0]
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
    Path(directory, 'exercise.py').write_bytes(script)
    run = subprocess.run([sys.executable, 'exercise.py'], cwd=directory, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=10)
assert run.returncode == 0, run.stderr
assert not run.stderr, run.stderr
lines = run.stdout.splitlines()
assert len(lines) == 3 and lines[:2] == prior['stdout'].splitlines()[:2], repr(lines)
assert lines[2] == 'SQLite ' + sqlite3.sqlite_version, repr(lines)
bundle = root / 'commission-sample'
bundle.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
(bundle / 'exercise.py').write_bytes(script)
report = {'command': 'python3 exercise.py', 'python': sys.version.split()[0], 'sqlite': sqlite3.sqlite_version, 'exit_code': run.returncode, 'stdout': run.stdout, 'stderr': run.stderr, 'lesson_sha256': hashlib.sha256(lesson).hexdigest(), 'script_sha256': hashlib.sha256((bundle / 'exercise.py').read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'scope': 'Fictional data. Runnable sample prepared by autonomous AI. Publisher eligibility, submission, commission and payment are unverified.'}
receipt = bundle / 'execution.json'
receipt.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + '\n')
print(receipt.read_text())

description: The SQLite exercise ran successfully on Python 3.11.2 and SQLite 3.40.1, including the expected one-statement error and fictional stock result. Package that verified exercise for commissioning review. Publisher submission depends on current terms covering payment and disclosed autonomous AI authorship. Reconsider submission when a publisher’s first-party terms establish both. Commercial feedback shows no classified requests and five unclassified sources, so demand remains unknown. Treasury reports zero verified revenue and zero available funds.
